_comment: cloud-ci-authz-coverage gate policy (issue #770; AUTH-005 pipeline-as-product backstop). R0 pack-shaped DATA — all repo-specifics live here, the Rust engine is neutral. Surface DISCOVERY is anchored on the ROUTE-INTRODUCTION call set (`.route(` / `.route_service(`) — NOT on a `Router::new()` constructor — so a Router::default()/Router::<S>::new()/aliased-binding/Router-parameter/builder-returned router, and a route declared after `.with_state(...)` or in a helper fn, are all discovered (PR #780 second-pass BLOCKER-1/2/3). Two route grammars are classified: axum `.route(path, METHOD(handler))` and the owned oya-http-router-kernel `.route(HttpMethod::X, path, handler)`. A control-plane surface (mutating method or per-resource path param) requires fail-closed authz: a router-level auth layer (auth_layer_idents, whole-token match) OR every mutating handler invoking a recognized authz guard (authz_guard_idents, whole-token + call-shape match). /healthz-style reads are exempt via exempt_path_substrings. Anything the engine cannot fully classify — an unresolved path, an unclassified method-router, a structurally-unclassifiable route call, or an unresolved .merge/.nest sub-router — fails CLOSED (AC-UNRESOLVED-ROUTE-PATH / AC-UNCLASSIFIED-METHOD / AC-UNCLASSIFIED-SURFACE / AC-UNRESOLVED-SUBROUTER), never silently skipped. Ratchets vs frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (today's known surfaces) so the gate lands green and only NEW unauthenticated control planes block. The remediation doctrine is intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.

_frozen_baseline_note: Pre-existing unauthenticated / unprovable HTTP control-plane surfaces, FROZEN and re-keyed by stable scope+signature (`<file>#<scope>::router[<sorted (method, route-path) tuples>]`) after the PR #780 SECOND-PASS review made surface DISCOVERY fail-closed (anchor on the route-introduction call set, classify the owned oya-http-router-kernel `(HttpMethod::X, path, handler)` grammar, whole-token auth-layer/guard matching). The broadened discovery surfaced MANY previously-invisible real routers; each below is pre-existing debt owned by its capability team, grandfathered so the gate lands GREEN and blocks only NEW unauthenticated control planes. SHRINK-ONLY + AUTOMATED: regenerate via the gate binary `--write` (drops fixed/removed keys); growing the baseline requires the explicit `--allow-new` flag (a reviewed grandfather), and a stale key self-cleans via AC-STALE-BASELINE. PER-SURFACE CLASSIFICATION — (A) GENUINE pre-existing unauthenticated mutating control planes (ESCALATE, owner must add fail-closed authz): billing/adapters/accounting-http (POST journals/payroll-postings/vat-workflow-plans — zero authz), iam/facade/tenant-rbac-app (POST policy-admissions/group-close-rollups/cross-service-workflow-plans/incident-rollback-plans/ops-commands — zero authz), oya/hr employment-infrastructure (POST employees/labor-compliance/leave-payroll-impact/sensitive-read-policy-decisions — zero authz), oya/payroll run-infrastructure (POST trial-closes/accounting-journal-drafts/hr-leave-impact-intakes — zero authz), oya/intelligence anthropic-compat-api (POST /v1/messages — zero authz), oya/intelligence openai-compat-api (POST /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings — zero authz), oya/intelligence provider-pool-app #build_app (POST /internal/seats/reload — zero authz), iam/facade/identity-workload-rest (POST /tokens/validate + POST /principals/{id_and_verb} do no caller-identity check; the sibling /authorize* are covered but the engine keys the whole scope), k8s/facade/control-plane-host (POST /admin/control-planes*), k8s/facade/cluster-lifecycle (POST /clusters — header-trust only), k8s/facade/tenant-quota (PUT/POST quota), oya/ci-controller (POST /gate-run), iam/ports/policy-cedar-api (POST /policies/{id}/versions/{v} publish_handler — zero authz guard; was previously false-exempted by naive /version substring match; BLOCKER fix exposes it; escalate to IAM team task #124), libs/oya-shared-backbone-rest-runtime-adapter #build_backbone_rest_router_with_state (loop-variable `route(method, route.path, handler)` — field-access path arg `route.path` classified as AC-UNCLASSIFIED-SURFACE by the MAJOR fix that closed the fail-open; engine cannot resolve path/method; escalate to platform team). (B) COVERED-but-UNPROVABLE (handlers ARE authz-covered but a path/method the engine cannot resolve fails it closed; remediation = make the path/method a literal/const the engine can resolve, NOT add authz): iam/facade/identity-service SCIM router (handlers call authorize_scim + authorize_token_for but routes use non-literal `&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/...")` paths → AC-UNRESOLVED-ROUTE-PATH), console/facade/workspace-shell-app #build_router (const-named GET paths the engine could not substitute → all reads but unresolved), iac/adapters/infrastructure #assemble_module_registry_http_service + oya/intelligence provider-pool-app #mount (loop-variable `route(method, template, handler)` calls — cross-crate const method + dynamic template path → AC-UNRESOLVED-ROUTE-PATH; the underlying registered routes are GET reads / registered elsewhere). NOTE: intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app are GREEN by authz detection (NOT baselined); oya/ci-webhook-gateway POST /webhook/github is GREEN via fail-closed signature verification (verify_any). Remediation per surface: see the doctrine in intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking vs a frozen baseline of currently-known unauthenticated surfaces. The two reference surfaces (intelligence/adapters/rest, tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app) are GREEN by construction (they carry authz). Pre-existing unauthenticated surfaces are frozen in frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (shrink-only). Only a NEW unauthenticated control plane blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing the policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: No shell/network/VCS. A read-only walk of the candidate tree's Rust source. Malformed policy, gate-id mismatch, and a below-floor surface census all fail closed.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: intelligence/adapters/rest/src/lib.rs (admin_tenant_allowed + PDP gate.decide + constant_time_eq) and tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app/src/lib.rs (authenticate_caller + authorize() per route).
